sections.heading: Environmental impact
sections.source_text:
MacBook Neo is designed to reduce environmental impact: 9
See the MacBook Neo Product Environmental Report (PDF) , opens in a new tab

sections.heading: Progress towards Apple 2030
sections.source_text:
Apple 2030 is our commitment to be carbon neutral for our entire carbon footprint. Our plan to decarbonise products is rigorous and focuses on transitioning to low‑carbon electricity, designing with recycled and low‑carbon materials and prioritising lower‑carbon ways of shipping products, like sea freight.
See Apple’s commitment

sections.heading: Materials
sections.source_text:
MacBook Neo is made with 60% recycled content, 10 including:
90% recycled aluminium
100% recycled cobalt and 95% recycled lithium in the battery
100% recycled rare earth elements in all magnets
100% recycled gold plating and tin solder in all Apple‑designed printed circuit boards
100% recycled copper in multiple printed circuit boards
80% recycled steel in the battery tray, keyboard link bars and speaker

sections.heading: Energy
sections.source_text:
45% of manufacturing electricity for MacBook Neo is sourced from renewable electricity 11
ENERGY STAR® certified 12

sections.heading: Waste
sections.source_text: No established final assembly sites generate waste sent to landfill as part of Apple’s Zero Waste Programme 14

sections.heading: Smarter chemistry
sections.source_text: All the materials used in Apple products, accessories and packaging are covered by the requirements of our Regulated Substances Specification (PDF), opens in new tab , which was one of the first in industry to restrict the use of key substances of concern. See the latest Environmental Progress Report to understand Apple’s recent efforts in phasing out these chemistries.
